                                You may need to add more flour, or you may not be able to

                                of the eggs. If the dough is sticky or extremely pliable, knead more
                                flour into it.

                                Divide the dough into three portions, cover with plastic wrap or an
                                overturned bowl, and allow to rest for at least 30 minutes.

                                Roll the dough out very thin on a lightly floured surface, one portion
